name: Jingkang Incident
title: Jingkang Incident
summary: An episode of invasions and atrocities that took place in 1127 during the Jin–Song wars when the troops of the Jurchen-led Jin dynasty besieged and sacked Bianjing, the capital of the Han-led Northern Song dynasty.
result: The Northern Song capital and territories north of the Huai River fell to the Jin
